student.title: Student sign-in
tour.caregiver.add.body: Give your student a name, a username and a 4-digit PIN, and choose their grade. They only need the username and PIN to sign in.
tour.caregiver.add.title: Add a student
tour.caregiver.data.body: Export downloads everything stored about a student. Delete removes the student and all of their progress. Only the person who added the student can delete them.
tour.caregiver.data.title: Your data
tour.caregiver.defaults.body: Choose a daily practice goal and a session limit, and decide whether you want the weekly email. These are the starting point for every student.
tour.caregiver.defaults.title: Set goals and limits
tour.caregiver.devices.body: On your student's device, open the student sign-in page. It shows a pairing code. Enter that code here to approve the device. Students can only sign in on devices you have approved.
tour.caregiver.devices.title: Approve their device
tour.caregiver.progress.body: Progress and goals shows how practice is going, lets you set real-world rewards like movie night, and makes printable worksheets.
tour.caregiver.progress.title: Read progress
tour.caregiver.share.body: Add a second caregiver by email. If they are new they get an invitation, and you can add a personal note to it.
tour.caregiver.share.title: Share with another caregiver
tour.caregiver.welcome.body: This quick tour shows how to get set up. It takes about a minute. You can skip it, and replay it any time with the Help link at the top.
tour.caregiver.welcome.title: Welcome to MathQuest
tour.label: Quick tour
tour.student.hints.body: Press Hint for a small nudge, then a bigger one, then the whole worked example. A hint earns a little less XP, never nothing.
tour.student.hints.title: Hints are fine to use
tour.student.learn.body: Not sure how to start? Press Show me how under a question to read a short lesson with pictures, then try one with help.
tour.student.learn.title: Learn it first
tour.student.map.body: See every skill on a map: what you have mastered, what you are working on, and what comes next.
tour.student.map.title: The skill map
tour.student.rewards.body: Every answer earns XP. Level up, keep a streak going, collect badges, and unlock avatars and colours.
tour.student.rewards.title: Earn XP
tour.student.tools.body: Open the scratchpad to work things out by drawing. The math keyboard helps you type fractions and symbols.
tour.student.tools.title: Scratchpad and math keyboard
tour.student.topics.body: Choose a topic or two, or tick Mix it up to practice a bit of everything. Then press Start practice.
tour.student.topics.title: Pick what to practice
tour.student.voice.body: In Settings you can have questions and feedback read aloud, and turn on high contrast, a dyslexia-friendly font, or calmer motion.
tour.student.voice.title: Read aloud and more
tour.student.welcome.body: Let's take a quick look around. You can skip this whenever you like.
tour.student.welcome.title: Welcome!

welcome.title: Welcome to MathQuest
welcome.shared: {who} shared {n} student(s) with you. Here is what you can see and do.
welcome.canOwner: As a parent (owner) you can see progress, set goals, send messages, make worksheets, approve devices, change a PIN, share a student with someone else and delete one. Another owner cannot remove you.
welcome.canHelper: As a helper you can see progress, set goals, send messages, make worksheets and approve devices. Only an owner can change a PIN, share or delete a student. You can leave a student at any time.
welcome.step1: On the student's device, open the app and choose the student sign-in, then press "Get a code".
welcome.step2: Type that code into "Approved devices" on this page and approve the device.
welcome.step3Owner: The student then signs in with their username and the 4-digit PIN you chose. You can change the PIN on the student's card.
welcome.step3Helper: The student then signs in with their username and a 4-digit PIN. Ask an owner if you need the PIN.
welcome.privacy: You only see the students shared with you. Each student has a recent activity list showing who looked at or changed things, and only the caregivers on that student can read it.
household.confirmShare: Share {names} with {email} as {role}? They will be able to see progress, goals and messages.
